public_sources.bound_semantics: LeaseSpec persists holderIdentity, leaseDurationSeconds, leaseTransitions and renewTime; lease duration is measured from the last observed renewTime.
An expired Lease can be acquired by another candidate; optimistic concurrency via resourceVersion allows only one competing update to succeed; leaseTransitions records holder changes.

chat_native_reduction.deadline_mapping: The frozen absolute controller-transition deadline is a logical-time analogue of persisted renewTime plus leaseDuration; reconstruction reads the same durable deadline rather than resetting it.
chat_native_reduction.fence_mapping: The post-abort generation fence is a role-local safety rule analogous to rejecting stale versioned ownership updates; Kubernetes resourceVersion/leaseTransitions support the stale-owner separation principle but are not claimed to implement this exact P7 token scheme.
chat_native_reduction.expiry_rule: Expiry converts only the still-pending oldest epoch to ABORTED; it never fabricates SUCCESS or credit.
chat_native_reduction.release_rule: Window/finality release occurs only after independent readback of the ABORTED/fence state.

credit_rule: At most one role-local credit after exact terminal readback; file creation alone earns zero credit.
scope_limit: Fixed role-local transition-count deadline trace only. No claim of wall-clock lease correctness, Kubernetes runtime acceptance, production liveness proof, or global mechanism novelty.
